name: Unwip 0.43.34
body:
Getting started:
- The main screen has a "Let's get you settled in" button until you've been through the welcome setup once. After that it becomes "Take a tour".
- The tour always has a book to walk round: if no book is open, it opens the Dracula example, and if you deleted that, Unwip makes it again (Unwip keeps its own copy).
